THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
016
STUDY 003
High-Key Beauty Portrait
Rights check
Source: 4570.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
A minimalist, high-key beauty portrait of an original
young woman against a near-white seamless
backdrop, framed vertically and cropped from the upper
chest up. Long, straight, glossy black hair falls past her
shoulders, with a few loose strands drifting across her
face. Her skin is smooth and matte, her lips a muted
rosy-brown, and her expression calm, direct, and
slightly contemplative. Her arms are folded across her
chest, one hand resting on the opposite shoulder, with
a thin silver band on one finger. Soft, even studio
lighting with little visible shadow, a cool, restrained
palette of off-white, pale blue-gray, and deep black,
generous negative space that keeps focus on her face
and hands. Clean, airy, serene, and quietly
melancholic, in the style of a contemporary skincare or
jewelry campaign.
Clean, airy, quietly melancholic
WORKING NOTES
- Suited to skincare, cosmetics, or jewelry campaigns.
- Could be warmed up or the pose changed.
Try this: Try a warmer palette.
